# njX UI

> njX UI is a lightweight, dependency-free CSS component library: 30+ components, 9 built-in themes switched with a single `data-theme` HTML attribute, zero build tools. 308 KB minified (44 KB gzipped). A classless mode (~48 KB) styles plain semantic HTML with zero classes. MIT license.

## Install

CDN (recommended — no build step):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/njx-ui@1.1.4/css/style.min.css">
<html data-theme="dark">
```

npm: `npm install njx-ui` (package name is `njx-ui`).

Optional JS helpers (theme toggle, tabs, modal, accordion, toast):

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/njx-ui@1.1.4/js/njx.js"></script>
```

## Themes

9 themes via one attribute: `dark | light | red | blue | green | cyan | yellow | pink | purple`.
Switch at runtime: `njxSetTheme('blue')` or set `data-theme` on `<html>`.

## Components

Buttons (50+ variants incl. gradient/glow/shine), Cards (30+), Navbar (5 variants), Tabs, Modal & Popup, Carousel & Slider (CSS scroll-snap + JS), Sidebar & Drawer, Collapse & Accordion, Toasts & Notifications, Skeleton loaders (shimmer/pulse/wave), Tags & Badges (30+), Forms, Tables, Dropdown, Progress, 60+ CSS animation utilities, 30+ hover effects, design tokens (CSS variables).
